When dereferencing and mapping properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, use `Array.isArray` to safely default to an empty array if the property is not an array, preventing `TypeError`s.

```javascript
      included_statuses: sortedUnique(
        Array.isArray(fixturePack.assertions)
          ? fixturePack.assertions.map((assertion) => assertion.status)
          : []
      ),
      excluded_statuses: sortedUnique(
        Array.isArray(fixturePack.excluded_assertions)
          ? fixturePack.excluded_assertions.map((assertion) => assertion.status)
          : []
      ),
```

Fixed in follow-up PR #1392. The fallback packet status summary now uses Array.isArray guards before mapping assertion fields and records fail-closed diagnostics for malformed assertion arrays.
Fixed in follow-up PR #1392. The validator candidate/review/blocked assertion check now treats non-array assertion fields as invalid without throwing, and the check fails closed.

Fixed in follow-up PR #1392. Added regression coverage for missing input artifacts, malformed JSON input, invalid assertion fields, and malformed packet assertion arrays, all asserting fail-closed diagnostics.
